parameters.name: event
parameters.description: What happened: "processed", "delivered", "open", "click", "bounce", "spam", "unsubscribe", "resubscribe", or "reject".

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: UTC timestamp of when the event happened.

parameters.name: sendtime
parameters.description: UTC timestamp of when the email was sent to our server.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: The 'envelope-from' email address.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The display name (where available) and email address the email was sent from.

parameters.name: from_address
parameters.description: The email address the email was sent from.

parameters.name: from_name
parameters.description: The display name set to accompany the email address (where available).

parameters.name: rcpt
parameters.description: The email address the email was addressed to.

parameters.name: recipients
parameters.description: The email addresses the email was sent to.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: The SMTP Username, API Key or IP Address used to send the email.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The recipient server that bounced the message (bounce only).

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The error message we got (where available).

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Contains additional information on the event (where available).

parameters.name: email_id
parameters.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies the email, which can be used to retrieve further details of the email delivery.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique id for the webhook.

parameters.name: message-id
parameters.description: The unique id from the sender.

parameters.name: bounce
parameters.description: This parameter will be included for a bounce event, and will be either hard or soft, depending on how we classify the bounce type.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The subject of the email.

parameters.name: user-agent
parameters.description: The "User-Agent" header of the device that opened the email (where applicable)

parameters.name: read-secs
parameters.description: The number of seconds an email was open - in five second increments up to a maximum of 30 (where applicable).

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: The reported client that clicked/opened the link (based on the User-Agent).

parameters.name: client-device
parameters.description: The reported device type of the User-Agent associated with the open/click event (where available).

parameters.name: client-os
parameters.description: The reported device operating system of the User-Agent associated with the open/click event (where available).

parameters.name: geoip-continent
parameters.description: A 2 character continent code based on a geoip lookup of the IP address associated with the open/click event (where available).

parameters.name: geoip-country
parameters.description: A 2 character country code based on a geoip lookup of the IP address associated with the open/click event (where available).

parameters.name: geoip-city
parameters.description: The name of the city based on a geoip lookup of the IP address associated with the open/click event (where available).

parameters.name: srchost
parameters.description: The IP address of the end-user associated with an open/click event (where available) or the IP address that submitted the email (for processed events).

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: What happened: "sms_submitted", "sms_delivered", "sms_rejected", "sms_sending", or "sms_failed".

parameters.name: destination_number
parameters.description: The number the SMS is being sent to.

parameters.name: email_subject
parameters.description: The subject of the email (if email to SMS).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique id for the webhook.

parameters.name: message_content
parameters.description: The body content of the SMS message.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: The unique id for the SMS.

parameters.name: received_timestamp
parameters.description: UTC timestamp of the event.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The destination based on the number's country code.

parameters.name: retry_count
parameters.description: The number of attempts to send the SMS.

parameters.name: sender_email
parameters.description: The From email address.

parameters.name: source_number
parameters.description: The pool/number the SMS was delivered from.

parameters.name: status_code
parameters.description: The status code of the SMS.

parameters.name: submitted_timestamp
parameters.description: UTC timestamp of when the SMS was submitted to the downstream provider.
